title: Output of the scenario-episode agent: an episode's screenplay

scenes.description: In episode order. Two to four for a whole episode.

fonction.description: (French) What the scene accomplishes in the episode.

genre.description: The scene's genre: it decides the cutting here and the writing guides of its plans later. action: a physical gesture or a clash; dialogue: characters talking to each other; montage: a series of brief moments that answer each other; contemplatif: a place or a state left to breathe; tension: a build-up or a tipping point.

ambiance.description: (French) The visual frame HELD over the whole scene, in one sentence: time of day, weather, general light. Sole exception to « no light » in this screenplay: it is continuity, not staging.

plans.description: In reading order. Order is that of the array: no plan number.

description.description: (French) What happens and why the plan exists, then the lines said (each `NAME : « exact text »`, in the dialogue language, before « État en fin de plan : »). Narrative, with no framing, light, sound or camera movement, and no reference to another plan.

liaison.description: How this plan links to the PREVIOUS one (its only link: the description refers to no other plan). suite: it takes up where the previous plan ends (same place, same moment or seconds later, same people where the previous « État en fin de plan » left them). coupe: a clean cut (another place, another moment, another point of view). The first plan of the episode is a coupe. When unsure: suite.

dureeSecondes.description: Generation duration, whole seconds, from 5 to 15 (never less than 5). It follows the brief's rhythm and the scene's genre (see the rules); group close moments into a single plan. A dialogue plan: generous duration, breathing margin of at least 2 s, to adjust after the voice take.

inventions.description: (French) Everything that was not in the brief. To validate or throw out.

notes.description: (French) Risky plans, duration trade-offs, proposed cuts for a dialogue that is too long. Empty if nothing to report.
